facts: William Thomson built the Huntingtons’ single-storey Moorish masonry winter home in1931–32.
Nominal200ft square, gray cement exterior, rough brick inner courts, flat roofs and simple brick parapets.
25 chimneys with rotating copper hoods;40ft central water/bell tower in covered walkway dividing two courts.
East3bays/recessed centre/semicircular patio; centre2doors/3windows, southeast8windows/northeast6, south7windows/door.
West doublegate entrance and separate small service courts. North small restroom projection.
Round brick arches, flower boxes and pierced brick low panels along covered walkway.
South sculptor studio25ft skylight; green iron grilles by Tito and Roger, Miami. Two east roof access stairs.
